newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Pusan City and other IPOs end limit up.
newsitem.headline: Pusan City and other IPOs end limit up.

text.p: Pusan City Gas Co and three other IPO shares closed their first day of trading at their upper limits on Monday, a Korea Stock Exchange statement said.
Pusan City Gas, a city gas supplier in the nation's second-largest city of Pusan, closed at 35,100, up 2,600 won from its base price of 32,500.
The base price is the weighted average of bids and offers received by the exchange and sets the trading range for the first trading day.
About 39,840 Pusan City Gas shares changed hands and the company offered its initial public offering at 19,000 won.
The statement said 630,060 shares remained unmatched, even though investors wanted to buy Pusan Gas at upper-limit prices.
Sewon Heavy, an industrial machinery manufacturer and an affiliate of Sewon Co, closed at 18,300 compared with its offer price of 15,000.
Duck Yang Industry Co rose 2,400 won to 32,400 from its base price of 30,000.
Kong Hwa Co Ltd closed at 42,100, up 3,100 from its base price of 39,000.
